Copy pages between files

Source: R/assemble.R
pdf_copy_pages.Rd

Copies pages of an open file into a writer, after the pages it already has, each with everything it uses (fonts, images, forms), so the result stands alone. Splitting, merging, reordering and rotating are all this: copy the pages wanted, in the order wanted, from each file in turn.

Usage

pdf_copy_pages(w, pdf, pages = NULL, rotate = 0)

Arguments

w

A pdf_writer from pdf_new().

pdf

A pdf_file from pdf_open(); it must stay open until the writer is saved.

pages

Page numbers, in the order to copy them (repeats allowed), or NULL for every page.

rotate

Degrees to add to each copied page's rotation, a multiple of 90.

Value

w, invisibly.

Examples

src <- pdf_open(system.file("examples", "hello.pdf", package = "zupdf"))
w <- pdf_new()
pdf_copy_pages(w, src, pages = c(2, 1), rotate = 90)
out <- pdf_open(pdf_save(w))
pdf_pages(out)$rotate
#> [1] 90 90
pdf_close(out)
pdf_close(src)
